name: control-doc
description: Sistema de Control Docente y Préstamos UPN con Cloudflare D1 Serverless Edge

scripts.build:apk: vite build && npx cap copy android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && copy /Y android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk public\control-doc.apk
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=control-doc --branch=main
scripts.sync: vite build && git add . && git commit -m "chore: actualizacion de sistema" && git push origin main && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=control-doc --branch=main
